BiblicalUsage: Par'âh is leadership, the leaders who take the lead. Deborah sings, Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this one verse praises leaders who lead and people who follow willingly: the song rises when both do their part.
